articles.title: Iran Allies Celebrate 'VICTORY' As American Soldiers Leave Iraq After Years Of Deployment
articles.description: After two decades of war, the United States is pulling its forces out of Iraq — and Iran is calling it a historic victory. As U.S. troops prepare to leave their last bases by September 30, questions are growing over whether Tehran-backed militias could expand their influence across Iraq.The U.S. invasion began in 2003 with the overthrow of Saddam Hussein, followed by years of occupation and counterinsurgency. American forces returned in 2014 to fight Islamic State, while Iraq increasingly became a strategic battleground between Washington and Tehran.
